notes: Draft configuration: The organizer identifies the historical 2.8-mile auto competition ROVAL. The pinned 2018 independent source retains the complete oval return, Northern rectangular infield hairpin, Eastern inner hairpin, Western infield S and short Southern diagonal chicane. The extra rectangular zigzag through the Northern paddock is excluded. Public-domain 2022 aerial imagery confirms these paved connections independently. The 4544.8 m trace remains unscaled against the 4509 m catalogue distance, with historical temporary barrier alignment and fine corner detail kept draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 4544.8 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 76 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been manually reviewed; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.
